name: dispatch
description: Operate dispatch, a local control plane for Codex lanes, through bundled skills and the derived MCP surface.

interface.longDescription: Dispatch provides local Codex lane orchestration: open owned lanes, attach existing lanes as observe-only, send/steer/brief/interrupt owned lanes, manage triggers, and expose the same operation registry through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Use dispatch to open a lane and send it a bounded request.
Use dispatch to add a safe trigger to an owned lane.
Use dispatch DM to send a short inter-lane message.
